nights.title: Jon B.
nights.name: Jon B.
nights.extract: Jonathan David Buck is an American R&B singer, songwriter and record producer. His debut album Bonafide (1995) spawned the hit singles "Pretty Girl" and "Someone to Love", the latter of which reached the top ten on the Billboard Hot 100 and was nominated at the Grammys Awards for Best Pop Collaboration with Vocals. His second album Cool Relax (1997), was certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). Cool Relax included the hit singles "Are U Still Down" and "They Don't Know". His third album, Pleasures U Like (2001) reached the top ten on the Billboard 200 chart.

nights.title: Buena Vista Social Club
nights.name: Buena Vista Social Club
nights.extract: Buena Vista Social Club was a musical ensemble primarily made up of Cuban musicians, formed in 1996. The project was organized by World Circuit executive Nick Gold, produced by American guitarist Ry Cooder and directed by Juan de Marcos González. They named the group after the members' club of the same name in the Buenavista quarter of Havana, a popular music venue in the 1940s. To showcase the popular styles of the time, such as son, bolero and danzón, they recruited a dozen veteran musicians, some of whom had been retired for many years.

nights.title: Svdden Death
nights.name: Svdden Death
nights.extract: Daniel James "Danny" Howland, better known by his alias Svdden Death, is a Los Angeles DJ and producer from San Jose, California. He is known for his song "Sell Out", a collaboration with American multi-platinum artist Marshmello that peaked on Billboard's Hot Dance/Electronic Songs at the No. 36 position in early 2019. Howland makes high-energy music that falls into the genre of dubstep and riddim.

nights.title: half alive: Billions Tour
nights.name: Half Alive
nights.extract: Half Alive is an American rock duo formed in Long Beach, California, in 2016. It consists of vocalist Josh Taylor and bassist J. Tyler Johnson, formerly accompanied by drummer Brett Kramer. The band began recording music in 2017, and have since released three studio albums, a compilation vinyl record, three extended plays of new material, three extended plays of live recordings, and many singles.

nights.title: Justin Nozuka
nights.name: Justin Nozuka
nights.extract: Justin Tokimitsu Nozuka  is an American singer, songwriter, and actor of Japanese and Canadian descent. His debut album, Holly, was released in 2007. He has since published five more studio albums: You I Wind Land and Sea (2010), Ulysees (2014), Run to Waters (2018), Daydreams & Endless Nights (2023), and Chlorine (2024).

nights.title: Steve Lacy: Oh yeah? Tour
nights.name: Steve Lacy
nights.extract: Steve Thomas Lacy-Moya is an American singer-songwriter, guitarist and record producer. He gained recognition as the guitarist of the alternative R&B band the Internet, which he joined in 2015. His self-produced debut EP, Steve Lacy's Demo (2017), was met with critical praise and became a sleeper hit. Lacy then guest performed alongside Frank Ocean on Tyler, the Creator's 2017 single "911 / Mr. Lonely", which received double platinum certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA). That year, he also co-wrote songs for artists including Solange Knowles, and Kendrick Lamar on his song "Pride".

nights.title: Jackson Dean
nights.name: Jackson Dean
nights.extract: Jackson Dean Nicholson is an American country music singer and songwriter. He signed to Big Machine Records in 2021 and had the singles "Don't Come Lookin'", "Fearless ", and "Heavens to Betsy" chart.

nights.title: Young Miko - Late Checkout Tour
nights.name: Young Miko
nights.extract: María Victoria Ramírez de Arellano Cardona, known professionally as Young Miko, is a Puerto Rican rapper, singer, songwriter and former footballer. In 2022, she released her debut extended play, Trap Kitty, featuring Latin trap tracks. In April 2024, she released her debut studio album, Att., featuring collaborations with Feid, Jowell & Randy, Villano Antillano, Elena Rose, and Dei V. In November 2025, she released her second studio album, Do Not Disturb, which featured a collaboration with Eladio Carrión.

nights.title: almost monday
nights.name: Almost Monday
nights.extract: Almost Monday is an American indie pop band based in San Diego, California.

nights.title: Yung Gravy: The Joyrider Tour
nights.name: Yung Gravy
nights.extract: Matthew Raymond Hauri, better known by his stage name Yung Gravy, is an American rapper.

nights.title: Shyne
nights.name: Shyne
nights.extract: Moses Michael Levi Barrow, best known by his stage name Shyne, is a Belizean politician and former rapper. He served as Leader of the Opposition in the House of Representatives, and the leader of the Belize United Democratic Party.

nights.title: The Menzingers: Everything I Ever Saw North American Tour
nights.name: The Menzingers
nights.extract: The Menzingers are an American punk rock band from Scranton, Pennsylvania, formed in 2006. The band consists of Greg Barnett, Tom May, Eric Keen (bass) and Joe Godino (drums). To date, the band has released eight studio albums, with their most recent, Everything I Ever Saw, released on July 17, 2026.

nights.title: Khantrast
nights.name: Khantrast
nights.description: Chinese-American rapper and singer from New York (born 2003)
nights.extract: Anthony Zhang, known professionally as Khantrast is a Chinese-American rapper from Brooklyn, New York City, USA. With his first releases being posted on Soundcloud in 2017, Khantrast has since grown to be a prominent figure in the Asian-American rap scene.

nights.title: Zade Dirani
nights.name: Zade Dirani
nights.extract: Zade Dirani, is a Jordanian American pianist and UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador for the Middle East and North Africa, of Damascene descent, whose genre blending songs are inspired by middle eastern music, Lebanese, pop, and classical music. He has performed before thousands around the world including Queen Elizabeth and Nelson Mandela.

nights.title: Victoria Monet - Frequency Of Love Tour
nights.name: Victoria Monét
nights.extract: Victoria Monét McCants is an American singer-songwriter. First gaining recognition for her songwriting work, Monét pursued a recording career with the release of a series of extended plays (EPs); her fifth, Jaguar (2020) was met with critical acclaim. Her debut studio album, Jaguar II (2023) became her commercial breakthrough and was supported by the hit single "On My Mama", which peaked within the top 40 of the Billboard Hot 100 and earned a Grammy Award nomination for Record of the Year. The nomination was among seven she received at the 66th Annual Grammy Awards, from which she won Best New Artist, Best R&B Album and Best Engineered Album, Non-Classical.

nights.title: Bruce Cockburn
nights.name: Bruce Cockburn
nights.extract: Bruce Douglas Cockburn is a Canadian singer-songwriter and guitarist. His song styles range from folk to folk- and jazz-influenced rock to soundscapes accompanying spoken stories. His lyrics reflect interests in spirituality, human rights, environmental issues, and relationships, and describe his experiences in Central America and Africa.

nights.title: The Army, The Navy
nights.name: The Army, The Navy
nights.extract: The Army, The Navy is an American folk-pop band consisting of Maia Ciambriello and Sasha Goldberg.

nights.title: Victoria Monét - Frequency Of Love Tour
nights.name: Victoria Monét
nights.extract: Victoria Monét McCants is an American singer-songwriter. First gaining recognition for her songwriting work, Monét pursued a recording career with the release of a series of extended plays (EPs); her fifth, Jaguar (2020) was met with critical acclaim. Her debut studio album, Jaguar II (2023) became her commercial breakthrough and was supported by the hit single "On My Mama", which peaked within the top 40 of the Billboard Hot 100 and earned a Grammy Award nomination for Record of the Year. The nomination was among seven she received at the 66th Annual Grammy Awards, from which she won Best New Artist, Best R&B Album and Best Engineered Album, Non-Classical.

nights.title: Madeon
nights.name: Madeon
nights.extract: Hugo Pierre Leclercq, better known by his stage name Madeon, is a French musician, DJ, record producer, singer and songwriter from Nantes, based in Los Angeles. He initially came to widespread public attention at age 17 through a YouTube video, "Pop Culture", where he performed a mash-up of 39 different popular songs in real-time using a Novation Launchpad. It received millions of hits in its first few days of release. Madeon has cited the Beatles and Daft Punk as his greatest musical influences.

nights.title: Joe Jordan
nights.name: Joe Jordan
nights.extract: Joseph Taylor Jordan was an American pianist, composer, real estate investor, and music publisher. He wrote over 2000 songs and arranged for notable people such as Florenz Ziegfeld, Orson Welles, Louis Armstrong, Eddie Duchin, Benny Goodman, and others.

nights.title: The Afghan Whigs
nights.name: The Afghan Whigs
nights.extract: The Afghan Whigs are an American rock band from Cincinnati, Ohio. They were active from 1986 to 2001, reformed briefly in 2006 and again from 2011 to present.

nights.title: Qendresa: Date Night Tour
nights.name: Qendresa
nights.extract: Qendresa is a British-Kosovar singer, songwriter, and producer from North West London. She is known for her self-produced electronic soul and personal songwriting. She has released two studio albums: Midnight Request Line (2020) and Londra (2024). She gained mainstream recognition in 2026 through her collaborations with Canadian rapper Drake across his albums Habibti and Maid of Honour.

nights.title: The Arcadian Wild
nights.name: The Arcadian Wild
nights.extract: The Arcadian Wild is an American acoustic string band based in Nashville, Tennessee. It began as a collaboration between friends at college in 2013 and has included several different members over the years. It has played and recorded with its current lineup since early 2020.

nights.title: Hawthorne Heights - 20th anniversary of If Only You Were Lonely
nights.name: Hawthorne Heights
nights.extract: Hawthorne Heights is an American rock band formed in Dayton, Ohio, in 2001. Originally called A Day in the Life, their lineup consists of JT Woodruff, Matt Ridenour and Mark McMillon.

nights.title: The OBGMs - Heart Problems
nights.name: The OBGMs
nights.extract: The OBGMs (The oOohh Baby Gimme Mores) are a Canadian punk rock band from Toronto, Ontario. They are most noted for their 2020 album The Ends, which was a shortlisted finalist for the 2021 Polaris Music Prize.
